questions.prompt: Did you paste a command into the Windows Run box (Win + R) or PowerShell, or run any GTA 6 PC installer, cloud player, crack, or keygen executable?
questions.helperText: Visually check your Downloads folder (%USERPROFILE%\Downloads) or browser download history (Ctrl + J) for files like GTA6Cloud.exe, gta6_installer.exe, GTAVI.exe, or GTA6 Keygen.exe without opening them.

questions.prompt: Do you see suspicious GTA 6 staging files or hidden folders in Windows File Explorer such as ls_trace.txt, GTA6Cloud, or IconCacheToDelete\0a3f2c91?
questions.helperText: Open File Explorer, turn on View > Show > Hidden items, and visually inspect %LOCALAPPDATA%\Temp\ls_trace.txt, %LOCALAPPDATA%\GTA6Cloud, and %LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\Windows\Explorer\IconCacheToDelete.

questions.prompt: Did you connect a cryptocurrency wallet or sign a transaction or token-approval prompt on a GTA 6 countdown, presale, or token website?
questions.helperText: Check your wallet extension's Connected Sites list or recent approval history (for MetaMask, Trust Wallet, Phantom, or WalletConnect) from a separate unaffected device.

questions.prompt: Did you enter Google, Steam, Discord, Rockstar, PlayStation, or Xbox credentials on an unofficial GTA 6 site, or sideload a GTA 6 Android APK?
questions.helperText: Check your browser history (Ctrl + H) for lookalike verification pages or inspect Android Settings > Apps for unofficial packages such as com.gta6.apkrate.

questions.prompt: Did you download a GTA 6 PC or mobile file without running it, or interact with an unlisted GTA 6 download site not yet in our database?
questions.helperText: Because Rockstar Games has not released an official PC or mobile version of GTA 6, any unknown or unlisted file is treated as Unverified / High Risk and must not be executed.

CRITICAL_INFECTED.headline: Treat this device as compromised immediately.
CRITICAL_INFECTED.summary: Your answers match active GTA 6 infostealer, ClickFix, or wallet-drainer campaigns documented by security vendors. Stolen session cookies and Web3 token approvals can bypass passwords and 2FA, so rapid containment from a separate unaffected device is essential.

steps.title: Disconnect from the internet immediately
steps.detail: Turn off Wi-Fi and unplug Ethernet on the affected device to halt ongoing credential exfiltration, C2 beacons, or hidden cryptocurrency mining.

steps.title: Rotate passwords and revoke all active sessions from a separate unaffected device
steps.detail: Using a different, uncompromised phone or computer, change passwords for Google, Steam, Discord, Rockstar, email, and banking accounts, enable app-based 2FA, and click 'Sign out of all sessions' to invalidate stolen cookies.

steps.title: Revoke crypto wallet approvals and move remaining funds
steps.detail: From an uncompromised device, revoke suspicious smart-contract spending approvals and transfer remaining assets to a newly generated wallet whose seed phrase was never exposed to the affected machine.

steps.title: Run a full system malware scan and consider an OS reinstall
steps.detail: Run a deep offline/full scan with an established antivirus engine; for confirmed ClickFix or Rust infostealer persistence (such as HKCU Run keys or injected processes), back up personal documents only and perform a full operating system reset.

HIGH_EXPOSURE.headline: Secure your accounts and remove unofficial mobile apps right away.
HIGH_EXPOSURE.summary: Entering credentials on lookalike OAuth or support pages or sideloading unofficial GTA 6 APKs exposes your accounts and device metadata to takeover or adware abuse. Act quickly to cut off unauthorized access before attackers pivot to linked services.

steps.title: Change exposed passwords and revoke active sessions
steps.detail: From an uncompromised device, reset your Google, Steam, Discord, Rockstar, PlayStation, or Xbox passwords, review authorized third-party OAuth apps, and sign out all active sessions.

steps.title: Uninstall any unofficial GTA 6 Android APK
steps.detail: Open Android Settings > Apps, remove any unofficial GTA 6 app (including com.gta6.apkrate), and disable 'Install unknown apps' permissions for your browser and file manager.

steps.title: Scan your device and monitor for phishing or unauthorized charges
steps.detail: Run a full security scan on the device and check email forwarding rules, payment statements, and gaming inventory history for unauthorized changes.

UNVERIFIED_CAUTION.headline: Do not open the file—no official GTA 6 PC or mobile version exists.
UNVERIFIED_CAUTION.summary: Even if you did not execute the download or the domain is not yet listed in published vendor advisories, every unofficial GTA 6 PC installer, crack, keygen, or mobile APK carries severe malware risk. Delete the file immediately and verify your system.

steps.title: Delete the downloaded archive or file without opening it
steps.detail: Permanently delete any downloaded GTA 6 ZIP, EXE, MSI, or APK file from your Downloads folder and empty the Recycle Bin or Trash.

steps.title: Run a precautionary security scan
steps.detail: Run a full scan with a reputable security tool to confirm no drive-by payload or browser extension was installed while visiting the site.

steps.title: Enable web protection against newly registered scam domains
steps.detail: Hundreds of new GTA 6 scam domains appear weekly; use real-time web threat protection and only verify GTA 6 platform releases directly on rockstargames.com.

UNVERIFIED_HIGH_RISK.headline: Unknown or unlisted GTA 6 PC/mobile files must be treated as high risk.
UNVERIFIED_HIGH_RISK.summary: Rockstar Games has released GTA 6 exclusively on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, with no official PC or mobile version available. An indicator absent from this database is never verified as benign and should be treated as potentially malicious.

steps.title: Do not download, extract, or run the file
steps.detail: Avoid running any unverified GTA 6 executable, script, or APK, and never paste website commands into Windows Run or PowerShell.

steps.title: Scan your device if you interacted with the site
steps.detail: Run a full system scan with an established antivirus tool and inspect your browser extensions for unexpected additions.

steps.title: Use real-time phishing and malicious-domain blocking
steps.detail: Enable web threat protection to block newly registered lookalike domains and wallet drainers before they load.
